title: NOMADOutputsResourceAttributes

model_system_ref.title: Model System Reference
model_system_ref.description:
Reference to the ModelSystem section in which the output physical properties were calculated.

- **Type**: string (reference ID).
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: REQUIRED in implementations.
  - **Query**: MUST be a queryable property with support for all mandatory filter features.
- **Examples**:
  - `"system_001"`
  - `"bulk_silicon_primitive_cell"`

model_method_ref.title: Model Method Reference
model_method_ref.description:
Reference to the ModelMethod section containing the details of the mathematical model with which the output physical properties were calculated.

- **Type**: string (reference ID).
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: REQUIRED in implementations.
  - **Query**: MUST be a queryable property with support for all mandatory filter features.
- **Examples**:
  - `"dft_pbe_001"`
  - `"gw_method_002"`

chemical_potentials.title: Chemical Potentials
chemical_potentials.description:
Array of chemical potential values calculated for the system.

- **Type**: array of ChemicalPotential objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: OPTIONAL support in implementations.
  - **Query**: SHOULD be queryable for filtering by chemical potential properties.
- **Examples**: See ChemicalPotential schema definition.

crystal_field_splittings.title: Crystal Field Splittings
crystal_field_splittings.description:
Array of crystal field splitting energies between degenerated orbitals.

- **Type**: array of CrystalFieldSplitting objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: OPTIONAL support in implementations.
  - **Query**: MAY be queryable for orbital analysis.

hopping_matrices.title: Hopping Matrices
hopping_matrices.description:
Array of tight-binding hopping matrix elements.

- **Type**: array of HoppingMatrix objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: OPTIONAL support in implementations.
  - **Query**: MAY be queryable for tight-binding analysis.

electronic_eigenvalues.title: Electronic Eigenvalues
electronic_eigenvalues.description:
Array of electronic eigenvalue data at k-points.

- **Type**: array of ElectronicEigenvalues objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: SHOULD be supported by implementations focused on electronic structure.
  - **Query**: SHOULD be queryable for electronic property filtering.

electronic_band_gaps.title: Electronic Band Gaps
electronic_band_gaps.description:
Array of electronic band gap values (direct/indirect).

- **Type**: array of ElectronicBandGap objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: SHOULD be supported by implementations focused on electronic structure.
  - **Query**: MUST be queryable for band gap filtering.

electronic_dos.title: Electronic Density of States
electronic_dos.description:
Array of electronic density of states data.

- **Type**: array of ElectronicDensityOfStates objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: SHOULD be supported by implementations focused on electronic structure.
  - **Query**: SHOULD be queryable for DOS analysis.

fermi_surfaces.title: Fermi Surfaces
fermi_surfaces.description:
Array of Fermi surface topology data.

- **Type**: array of FermiSurface objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: OPTIONAL support in implementations.
  - **Query**: MAY be queryable for metallic systems analysis.

electronic_band_structures.title: Electronic Band Structures
electronic_band_structures.description:
Array of electronic band structure data along k-paths.

- **Type**: array of ElectronicBandStructure objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: SHOULD be supported by implementations focused on electronic structure.
  - **Query**: SHOULD be queryable for band structure analysis.

total_energies.title: Total Energies
total_energies.description:
Array of total energy values for the system.

- **Type**: array of TotalEnergy objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: MUST be supported by all implementations.
  - **Query**: MUST be queryable for energy-based filtering and analysis.

kinetic_energies.title: Kinetic Energies
kinetic_energies.description:
Array of kinetic energy components.

- **Type**: array of KineticEnergy objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: OPTIONAL support in implementations.
  - **Query**: MAY be queryable for energy decomposition analysis.

potential_energies.title: Potential Energies
potential_energies.description:
Array of potential energy components.

- **Type**: array of PotentialEnergy objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: OPTIONAL support in implementations.
  - **Query**: MAY be queryable for energy decomposition analysis.

total_forces.title: Total Forces
total_forces.description:
Array of total forces on atoms in the system.

- **Type**: array of TotalForce objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: SHOULD be supported by implementations focused on structural properties.
  - **Query**: SHOULD be queryable for force analysis.

temperatures.title: Temperatures
temperatures.description:
Array of system temperature values.

- **Type**: array of Temperature objects.
- **Requirements/Conventions**:
  - **Support**: OPTIONAL support in implementations.
  - **Query**: SHOULD be queryable for thermodynamic analysis.

temperature.description: Temperature at which chemical potential was calculated (Kelvin).

particle_number.description: Number of particles in the system.

n_orbitals.description: Number of orbitals involved in the splitting.
Number of orbitals in the hopping matrix.

value.description: Complex hopping matrix elements (Joule). Array represents complex numbers as [real, imag] pairs.

spin_channel.description: Spin channel index (0 for up, 1 for down).

momentum_transfer.description: Momentum transfer for indirect band gaps.

origin.description: Origin or source of temperature measurement.

description:
NOMAD simulation outputs resource attributes following OPTIMADE specification. Contains arrays of computed physical properties with references to the computational model and system.

## Property Categories
- **Electronic Properties**: eigenvalues, band gaps, DOS, band structures, Fermi surfaces
- **Energy Properties**: total, kinetic, and potential energies with decompositions
- **Force Properties**: forces on atoms with contribution analysis
- **Thermodynamic Properties**: temperature, chemical potentials
- **Specialized Properties**: crystal field splittings, hopping matrices for tight-binding

## Key Relationships
- **System Link**: `model_system_ref` connects to the simulated system
- **Method Link**: `model_method_ref` connects to computational methodology
- **Property Decomposition**: Many properties support contribution arrays
- **Cross-References**: Properties can reference each other (e.g., band structure ↔ band gap)

## Implementation Notes
- All property arrays support empty defaults for optional properties
- Energy properties should be queryable for thermodynamic analysis
- Electronic properties are essential for materials science databases
- Units are specified using `x-optimade-unit` extension for physical quantities
- Complex numbers in hopping matrices represented as [real, imag] arrays
